records.part: Antenna Control System (ACS) with associated equipment and installation
records.reason: The required ACS is required to be compatible with the mechanical, electrical, and network architecture of a twin AN/FSC-78 Antenna System ACS already in use at the same Facility.

records.part: Brushless DC motors, azimuth axis, permanent magnet type, 40 HP
records.reason: Antenna Control System must be capable of controlling a total of four brushless DC motors: 2, 40 HP in azimuth and 2, 10.6 HP in elevation.

records.part: Brushless DC motors, elevation axis, permanent magnet type, 10.6 HP
records.reason: Antenna Control System must be capable of controlling a total of four brushless DC motors: 2, 40 HP in azimuth and 2, 10.6 HP in elevation.
Antenna Control System must use Kollmorgen motor controllers, variable speed.

records.part: Position Encoders, 25 Bit Resolution, +/-20 Arc-Second accuracy per revolution
records.reason: Position encoder must be two, Heidenhain Position Encoders with 25 Bit Resolution and +/-20 Arc-Second accuracy per revolution.

records.part: Portable Maintenance Unit for manually commanded, bi-directional control of all axes
records.reason: Antenna Control System must include a Portable Maintenance Unit that provides manually commanded, bi-directional control of all axes, hand held, backup means of moving antenna and ACU independent, four line 20 character display for axis positions, mode, and scrolling status messages, modes to include position jog and hi/lo variable speed, and a function to enable/disable the antenna per axis.

records.part: Power Drive Unit cabinet, stainless steel, NEMA-4X rated enclosure
records.reason: Power Drive Unit cabinet must be stainless steel, NEMA-4X rated enclosure.
A drive isolation transformer must be part of the Antenna Control System.

records.part: Antenna Control Unit display, 15-inch touch screen LCD color display
records.reason: Antenna Control Unit display must be 15" touch screen LCD color display with Az/El actual and commanded positions, currently selected modes/states, summary fault indicator and individual status and fault message display.

records.part: Power Drive Unit Logic redundancy component set (Antenna Control Board, Expansion Board, PLC Arbitrator, T-Bar Relay, and associated Power Supplies)
records.reason: Redundant component must include an additional Antenna Control Board, Expansion Board, PLC Arbitrator, T-Bar Relay, and associated Power Supplies.
